$comment: Vanilla API tables of components without a create<Name> controller (leadAmendments A6). Step 30 compares such a table with the classes and data-*/aria-* attributes that the '## Stable class and state API' table of the @hawiyah/styles README documents for the component's classes (components.json cssClasses), plus a row 'class'. Attributes defined by HTML or ARIA have no machine-readable Hawiyah declaration and are listed under nativeAttributes; documented attributes the page leaves out are listed under notListed. Requiredness is not checked for these tables, because the contract declares none. Every entry needs a reason and the lead's review.

vanilla.reason: Button is a native button element styled by the class hw-button, and @hawiyah/vanilla 0.3.0 exports no createButton (its only export with Button in the name is createCopyButton, the controller of the copy button). The Actions row of '## Stable class and state API' in the @hawiyah/styles 0.3.0 README documents hw-button, data-variant, data-size and data-icon-only, which step 30 reads as the contract.

nativeAttributes.type: HTML attribute of the button element, not a Hawiyah declaration; the page lists it because the browser default of a button in a form is submit.
nativeAttributes.disabled: HTML attribute of the button element, not a Hawiyah declaration; the '## Semantics and behavior' section of the @hawiyah/styles README asks for genuine disabled controls, and dist/styles.css styles .hw-button:disabled; the loading state writes it.
nativeAttributes.aria-busy: ARIA attribute (WAI-ARIA 1.2 aria-busy), not a Hawiyah declaration; dist/styles.css of @hawiyah/styles 0.3.0 has the rule .hw-button[aria-busy='true'], and the loading state writes aria-busy="true" with disabled.

vanilla.review: Checked by 4c.3 against leadAmendments A6 and the README and dist/styles.css of @hawiyah/styles 0.3.0 as installed: the component has no controller, the contract rows are read from the README, and each native attribute is defined by HTML or WAI-ARIA and used by a rule of the published stylesheet. No documented attribute is left out (no notListed entry).
